english.note: Use this for an offshore business or financial arrangement, especially one involving tax or labour-cost advantages.

examples.english: The company moved part of its business to an offshore jurisdiction to reduce tax costs.
examples.traditional: 呢間公司將部分業務搬去離岸地區，以減低稅務成本。
